message:
Let me test the fuzzer with the seed corpus files to see if any trigger the uninitialized read. First, let me check if the binary is built with MSan or ASan.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>ldd /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build/xaac_dec_fuzzer 2>&1 | head -20 && echo "---" && strings /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/build/xaac_dec_fuzzer | grep -i -E "memorysanitizer|addresssanitizer|undefined" | head -10</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
